mail.emailChanged.body:
The email address of your {site} account was changed.

From now on, password reset links and sign-in codes go to the new address. Reset links that were still open were cancelled.

If this was not you, someone with access to your session changed it: sign in, review Settings, Account, and ask your administrator for help if you cannot.
mail.emailChanged.subject: Your qinqin email address was changed
mail.loginCode.body:
Your sign-in code for {site} is:

{code}

It is valid for {minutes} minutes and works once.

If this was not you, ignore this message and do not share the code with anyone.
mail.loginCode.subject: Your qinqin sign-in code
mail.mfaCode.body:
Your two-step check code for {site} is:

{code}

It is valid for {minutes} minutes and works once.

If this was not you, someone knows your password: change it and ignore this code.
mail.mfaCode.subject: Your qinqin two-step code
mail.reset.subject: Reset your qinqin password
mail.test.body:
This is a test message from {site}. Email delivery works.

If this was not you, ignore this message: it was sent by an administrator of the site.
mail.test.subject: qinqin test message
mail.verifyEmail.body:
Confirm this email address for your {site} account with this code:

{code}

It is valid for {minutes} minutes.

If this was not you, ignore this message: the address stays unconfirmed.
mail.verifyEmail.subject: Confirm your email address for qinqin
